executiveSummary.headline: Make the Hotel-Theater Proposition and Central-Madrid Assets Easier to Resolve
executiveSummary.lead: UMusic Hotel Madrid has a distinctive official proposition—130 rooms, direct access to the 898-seat Teatro Albéniz, four meeting rooms, central walkability, and seasonal rooftop amenities—but appeared in only 2 of 46 eligible scenarios. The action plan focuses on precise hotel-theater packaging, seasonal amenity clarity, planner facts, and small official-page hygiene issues.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 184 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 46 eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. No certified peer position is available. Reality Gap summarizes tested attribute recognition and does not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: The Signature Hotel-Theater Offer Is Specific but Lightly Captured
themes.what: The official site documents direct lobby access to the 898-seat Teatro Albéniz and a 130-room five-star hotel, while scenario presence was 4.3%.
themes.whyItMatters: The opportunity is to package verified decision context, not to promise ranking movement.

themes.title: Central and Rooftop Assets Are Under-Recognized
themes.what: Walkable downtown was recognized at 7.1%, outdoor pool 10%, fitness 14.3%, city views 20%, and terrace rooms 5.7%.
themes.whyItMatters: Official pages already support these attributes but need consistent seasonal and location qualifiers.

themes.title: Small Official-Page Errors Weaken Precision
themes.what: The theater page repeats “TEATRP” in event addresses, and a 2026 Splash Pass remains under a 2025 URL slug.
themes.whyItMatters: Simple hygiene fixes reduce ambiguity in otherwise strong first-party content.
